prospectus_recommendation.candidate: The prospectus of Orissa Theatres Limited imagined a wider route for literature: filming Odia authors’ dramas, novels and stories. It named Kalicharan Pattnaik as production officer and included Mayadhar Mansingh and Kalindi Charan Panigrahi among its literary advisers. Its plans extended to a studio, touring cinemas and training artists and technicians—ambitions recorded in the prospectus, rather than proof that each was realised.
prospectus_recommendation.note: Orissa Theatres Limited, Prospectus, undated, printed pp.4–5,7–8; Odia Bibhaba/Srujanika scan.

prospectus_recommendation.spelling_limit: Source prints Mayadhar Manasingh and Kalandi Charan Panigrahi; proposed prose uses familiar normalized names. Keep source spellings in evidence.
